record.body:
## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD 03d561c). This is a repair: reproduce with a keys-only pilot test first. Parent probe against the real store at 120x40: after load, app.focused is ContentTabs; down leaves DataTable.cursor_row at 0; tab (bound priority=True to next_effort) never moves focus. Keep tab/shift+tab as effort switching. Later tasks in this phase replace the tiles with status tabs and group the table by phase, so keep focus logic in one helper they can reuse. Run full suites sparingly: the user reports tmux lag during heavy test runs.
record.subject: keyboard-focus
